results.overview: The third installment of Tux and Fanny

results.title: Jimmy
results.overview: A look into the life of American actor James Stewart, whose inspiring tale of valor, purpose and faith will win over everyone.

results.title: Mouse
results.overview: When her closest friendship is suddenly disrupted the summer before senior year, a teenager struggles to find her footing and develops an unexpected, complicated bond with her best friend’s mother.

results.title: Love & Sex on Streaming
results.overview: Having stumbled upon a crazy sex video featuring his girlfriend and her ex-boyfriend, and his perception of sex and love overturned by a sexy camgirl, a young man found himself in the world of live streaming.

results.title: The Invisible Guest
results.overview: Accused of murdering her lover, a young businesswoman hires a brilliant lawyer. With only three hours left, they must uncover what really happened.

results.title: Being Heumann
results.overview: Scrappy, defiant, and done being treated like a burden, Judy Heumann turns her outrage into a revolution. In 1977, she and more than 100 disability rights protestors send a very loud message: The system is broken—not us.

results.title: Nooru Kodi Vaanavil
results.overview: Vino and Fenny's lives intertwine in a poignant tale of love, hope, and heartbreak.

results.title: A Quiet Day
results.overview: It’s an ordinary day at the United Nations. Nothing unexpected, really. Except, perhaps, for this strange affliction that is spreading amongst the members of the council. But otherwise, everything is fine. Yes, everything is perfectly fine.

results.title: Angélica
results.overview: A chance encounter on a cold, misty morning on the outskirts of Valdivia changes the life of 33-year-old Angélica forever. After a brief, mundane ten-minute conversation with Fernando—a wandering passerby—he vanishes without a trace. From that day on, Angélica’s life becomes a nightmare: she finds herself the "key witness" in the case, subjected to intense public scrutiny, hate campaigns on social media, and harassment by the family’s lawyer, Raúl.

results.title: Forsaken
results.overview: A man trapped in his thoughts relives his last moments.

results.title: El vuelo de los cóndores
results.overview: Vania, a young and enigmatic police officer, arrives at Laura’s remote cabin under the pretext of completing her tactical diving training in freezing waters. However, she is concealing her true objective: to uncover the truth about her own past and her connection to Laura.

results.title: Retrato de una memoria
results.overview: An elderly widower lives alone until a child’s presence intrudes upon his home. This small visitor completely disrupts his isolation, stripping away the last tangible links he has to his late wife. In his attempt to recover them, the old man is forced to revisit forgotten corners of his own house. Despite his initial resistance, the child insists on leading him to an abandoned greenhouse—a space that once belonged to his wife. Amidst plants beginning to sprout anew and the heavy burden of grief, the two forge an unexpected bond that helps them process their loss. Only then does the old man feel ready to fulfill his final wish: a long-awaited reunion with her.

results.title: Dear Henry: Our Fight for Justice
results.original_title: Dear Henry: Our Fight for Justice
results.overview: Henry Nowak’s family speak for the first time.  In this documentary, they say they may have been “manipulated in their darkest hours” by both Hampshire and Isle of Wight Constabulary and the police watchdog in the months following his murder.  Bodycam footage shows the officers arresting Henry as he lay dying on the ground.  The family has spoken to ITV News’ UK Editor Paul Brand about the way Henry was treated and their own dealings with the police in the months after his death.

results.title: Chicken Tenders And Hard Liquor
results.overview: A college student gets too fond of a cooked chicken after a night of hard drinking, and wakes up to some unusual consequences.

results.title: Mystery Science Theater 3000: The RiffTrax Experiments — The Mummy Theme Park
results.original_title: Mystery Science Theater 3000: The RiffTrax Experiments — The Mummy Theme Park
results.overview: The RiffTrax Experiments continue with Mummy Theme Park! All the best theme parks have “Theme Park” right in their names, right? That’s why the theme park in Jurassic Park turned out to be such a mess — if only they’d called it “Big Bitey Lizard Theme Park,” the guests would’ve known what they were in for.

results.title: Don't Go In The Garden
results.overview: After a serious accident in an attempt to trim down her overgrown garden, Lily has a chilling encounter with something terrifying lurking beneath the soil.

results.title: Hollow
results.overview: The young Lennart, a poor farmer, is out hunting with a friend when he stumbles and falls down in a hidden cave. And his life is forever altered.

results.title: Buen Viaje, Javier
results.overview: It is the final encounter between América and Javier. América pays him to visit and listen to her most intimate and disturbing stories. She pays, he obeys... perhaps a contract, an agreement to stay afloat. How many stories can a body hold after listening to them? Javier becomes the involuntary keeper and accomplice of América’s darkest secrets, while she remains alone. Now everything about her lives inside him.
